name: JCET Group Co., Ltd.
summary: JCET Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated-circuit back-end and technology services in China, South Korea, the United States, and internationally. The company offers turnkey solutions, including semiconductor package integration design, wafer probing, bumping, assembly, final testing, and global drop shipments; design solutions; and characterization services, such as mold flow, mechanical, and electrical analysis, as well as thermal analysis test.
